description: This header file declares functions and namespaces related to naming conventions within the ONNX export process in the PyTorch JIT compiler. It provides utility functions for generating and managing scope names, variable names, and scope compatibility checks.

methods.name: createFullScopeName
methods.description: Generates a full scope name given a class name and variable name.

methods.name: variableName
methods.description: Returns the variable name for a given scope pointer.

methods.name: variableNameFromRoot
methods.description: Returns the variable name from the root scope given a scope pointer and layer separator.

methods.name: className
methods.description: Returns the class name associated with a scope pointer.

methods.name: classNameFromRoot
methods.description: Returns the class name from the root scope with a layer separator.

methods.name: isCompatibleScope
methods.description: Checks if a scope is compatible within the context of ONNX naming conventions.

methods.name: AssignScopedNamesForNodeAndValue
methods.description: Assigns scoped names to nodes and values within a computational graph.
